quests.title: Tatara Tales: Priority Investigation

dialogue.t: Hello there, my dear, gallant girl(boy)! I have good news and bad news regarding the Mikage Furnace. Which would you like to hear first?
The good news is that the core's only suffered some minor damage. It is still within my power to fix it.
The bad news, however, is that the Fatui poking around in there don't seem to appreciate this piece of good news.
They very much seem to be searching for a way to get their grubby hands on the Tatarigami core.
But if we let them meddle any further, the Tatarigami's power will get out of control. This entire island will be blown sky-high with us still on it.
However, if we focus solely on the Fatui, the Tatarigami energy built up inside the containment dome will eventually reach its limit all the same...

dialogue.sit: So we need to deal with both of them at the same time?

dialogue.t: Well... Put simply, academically speaking, in an objective sense...
We are facing two separate problems here: the Fatui and the Tatarigami.
But with how the situation is inside the Mikage Furnace, whichever problem we choose to tackle, we're likely to have to face the other in the process.
So, ultimately, the fact of the matter is—
Um, yes, that's correct. We need to deal with both of them at the same time.
But one step at a time. As the Liyue saying goes, "don't rush to eat hot tofu, or you'll burn your tongue."

dialogue.sit: How come you know Liyue proverbs?

dialogue.t: We've been to Liyue before. I'd consider this little gem of wisdom a souvenir from the trip.
I have a lot more of these souvenirs where that one came from. I must confess to having imbibed all of my "souvenirs" from Mondstadt, though... they were really very good.
Let's get back on track. I have a teensy-tiny plan to fix this Mikage Furnace situation, but I will need your help.

dialogue.sit: Well, what do I get out of this?

dialogue.t: Ha! Forthright and ready for a fight! That's what I like about you!
Ahem. I digress. Now, hold on to these Sensor Beacons, if you please.
I need you to place them in a number of locations for me.

What these Sensor Beacons will do is gather data on the density and distribution of Tatarigami energy within the Mikage Furnace. Once armed with this data, I should be able to come up with a more detailed plan.
I shall leave it in your hands, indeed.
I will mark the locations for the beacons on your map. I'll be counting on you, Traveler!
Hopefully this is as far as the situation escalates...
Have you placed those beacons?
Well done, now all we have to do is to let them collect the data.

dialogue.sit: How did you know where to put them?

dialogue.t: I was part of the design team for the Mikage Furnace. By placing beacons in these locations, we can gather data on almost all the areas inside.
Hmm, you know, if we set up purifying devices in these locations, our troubles would be over overnight.
If Mr. Flois knew half of what had happened here, he'd go completely ballistic...
Alright, thanks for your help. Please take these as compensation.
Ahem, one other thing... I may possibly, probably, definitely need you to help me retrieve the beacons again at some point over the next few days.
I don't have a Vision, after all, so I can't simply stroll into somewhere with such a high concentration of Tatarigami energy.

Not to mention that those, hmm, rough-and-tough Fatui folks are still there. I honestly think you are the only person on this whole island capable of dealing with them and the furnace at the same time.

quests.description: Xavier, who is researching the Mikage Furnace, seems to have had some new idea…
